headline: Global Patching of Critical PHP Flaw Causes Temporary Website Disruptions
summary: Governments and businesses across multiple countries, including Kenya and the Netherlands, scrambled to patch a critical security flaw in PHP, temporarily taking some websites offline.
why: PHP powers a substantial portion of the world's web servers and enterprise content management systems. Widespread patching can cause temporary business disruption and exposes enterprise IT vulnerabilities.

impacts.name: Information Technology
impacts.why: Organizations faced operational downtime and emergency remediation expenses to patch the flaw.
